stage.terms.1.title: Physical Risk Acknowledgment
stage.terms.1.content: Powerlifting involves maximal loads that place extreme stress on the musculoskeletal and central nervous systems. You acknowledge that you are performing these movements at your own risk.
stage.terms.2.title: Equipment Integrity
stage.terms.2.content: You verify that all equipment (bars, plates, racks, collars) is in good working order and that safety spotters or pins are correctly positioned for your specific anthropometry.
stage.terms.3.title: Biometric Monitoring
stage.terms.3.content: Volt Arena provides real-time biometric telemetry. These metrics are for informational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice or your own internal perception of safety.
stage.terms.4.title: Emergency Protocol
stage.terms.4.content: In the event of a failed lift, follow standard safety procedures: dump the bar safely if using pins, or rely on your spotters. Do not attempt to "save" a lift that has clearly deviated from a safe path.
stage.terms.5.title: CNS Fatigue Management
stage.terms.5.content: Maximal effort training causes significant neural fatigue. If the system detects a velocity drop below the safety threshold, it may recommend aborting the session.
stage.terms.6.title: Data Privacy
stage.terms.6.content: Your performance data is encrypted and stored locally. Aggregated, anonymized data may be used to improve the Arena's predictive algorithms.
stage.terms.7.title: Final Authorization
stage.terms.7.content: By clicking "Accept & Start", you authorize the initiation of the competition sequence and confirm you are in a physical state capable of high-intensity exertion.
